nodes.label: Reference Identity and Corporate Action Truth Layer
nodes.rationale: Reference is the truth layer for instrument identity, temporal existence, taxonomy, and corporate actions used to interpret downstream market observations.

nodes.label: Reference Corporate Action Causal Value
nodes.rationale: Reference's strongest causal value currently comes from ticker changes and, more selectively, splits rather than static identity metadata.

nodes.label: FINRA Official Short Baseline
nodes.rationale: FINRA is the official certification baseline for short data, while Polygon is a secondary comparative layer.

nodes.label: Short Causal Overlay Policy
nodes.rationale: Short volume is primarily daily market-anomaly context and becomes strong causal evidence only near coherent halts; short interest is slow crowding or squeeze-risk context and is not fine intraday causal evidence by default.

nodes.label: FINRA Short Baseline Policy
nodes.rationale: FINRA short volume and short interest are the official baselines; Polygon short is retained only as a comparative and secondary coverage layer.

nodes.label: Append-Only Trades Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Agent02 v2 uses append-only Parquet events plus validation checkpoints and manifests as its operational source of truth, while CSV and JSON outputs remain compatibility materializations.

nodes.label: Trade Scale-Mismatch Reclassification
nodes.rationale: trade_price_outside_daily_range should not automatically produce HARD_FAIL; coherent price and inverse-volume scale mismatches should be classified and degraded to SOFT_FAIL, reserving HARD_FAIL for unexplained or structurally compounded range breaks.

nodes.label: Global Certification Verdict Policy
nodes.rationale: The final verdict must be reproducible and explicitly resolve expected presence, observed presence, health, intended use, blockers, exclusions, and known non-blocking limitations.

nodes.label: 1m Full-Scope Limitation
nodes.rationale: The operational policy is reusable, but existing materialized proportions describe ohlcv_1m_current_full and must not be presented as explicit less-than-1B results.

nodes.label: 1m Layered Recovery
nodes.rationale: Most 1m events should be rescued through schema-only or schema-plus-VW paths; only a very small parse-invalid or price-invalid tail requires hard quarantine.

nodes.label: Additional Subblock Quality Policy
nodes.rationale: Financials core is good, financial ratios remain review due to sparse coverage, news and IPOs are mixed contextual layers, corporate actions are secondary to reference, and economic data is good at macro level but review for ticker-level causality.

nodes.label: Daily Coverage Recovery Policy
nodes.rationale: Likely valid gaps are recoverable without penalty, ambiguous gaps are recoverable with a flag, and unexpected gaps with complete 1m, quotes, and trades evidence remain review_not_rehabilitated rather than being treated as raw bad data.

nodes.label: Daily Quality Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Most VW residue is recoverable as edge behavior or illiquid-regime review; only hard parse or non-positive OHLC failures belong to the bad exclusion set.

nodes.label: Global Metrics Tables Traceable Plain Paths
nodes.norm_label: global metrics tables traceable plain paths

nodes.label: Halts Builder Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Almost all of the multisource row mismatch is explained by NASDAQ deduplication; the remaining two-row discrepancy is marginal and does not change block certification.

nodes.label: Halts as Operational Event Truth
nodes.rationale: The quotes and trades overlay demonstrates that official halt events provide operational causal context; market-data problem flags do not invalidate halts and often reinforce their explanatory value.

nodes.label: Halts Causal Market Context
nodes.rationale: Halts has real causal value when joined with quotes and trades, while its structurally unusable residue is materially negligible.

nodes.label: Quotes Audit Reuse
nodes.rationale: Certification should assemble canonical audit artifacts instead of repeating the local quotes audit or inventing a new taxonomy.

nodes.label: Quotes Expected Set Constraints
nodes.rationale: Any future expected set must respect the sub-1B universe, point-in-time ticker life, and the actual temporal scope of the materialized dataset.

nodes.label: Deferred Quotes Local Build
nodes.rationale: A new local certification build is deferred until global assembly decisions are closed.

nodes.label: Causal Context And Operational Quality Separation
nodes.rationale: A halt can explain an episode without making a fragile quote book operationally clean.

nodes.label: Unequal Reference Causal Strength
nodes.rationale: Reference is broadly usable, but confidence differs across identity, events-to-halts, splits-to-trades, and events-to-quotes.

nodes.label: Short Provider Asymmetry
nodes.rationale: FINRA is the primary baseline, while Polygon is limited to comparison, secondary coverage, or a fresh sub-1B root.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Trades Certification Base
nodes.rationale: Trades certification combines the full indexed universe for coverage, D full root-cause output for residual breadth, and file_acceptance for final acceptance semantics.

nodes.label: File Acceptance Reinterpretation
nodes.rationale: The old D full final bucket measures residual mass but mixes scale effects into broad break buckets, so file_acceptance must reinterpret it for certification.

nodes.label: Trades Old Versus New Bucket Bridge
nodes.norm_label: trades old versus new bucket bridge

nodes.label: Old-to-New Trades Bucket Bridge
nodes.rationale: D full supplies residual breadth while file_acceptance supplies certification semantics; broad old buckets must not be promoted or condemned without reinterpretation.

nodes.label: Provisional Trades Certification Policy
nodes.rationale: Use file_acceptance as the primary semantics, retain explained residuals as review, reserve bad for bad_data, and avoid expanding good without sufficient canonical full-run evidence.

nodes.label: Trades Bucket Policy Synthesis
nodes.rationale: Specific explained buckets remain review, bad_data maps to bad, good alone maps to good, and generic review requires further segmentation.

nodes.label: No-1m Reference Recovery Policy
nodes.rationale: Files without a 1m anchor may be recovered with a flag when daily scale and VWAP alignment are clean and no bad-data or scale-mismatch signature is present.

nodes.label: Stable Scale Reconciliation Requirement
nodes.rationale: Reference scale mismatch remains explained review until a stable per-file rescaling rule or a safely reconcilable subfamily is validated against daily and 1m references.

nodes.label: Microstructure Recovery Policy
nodes.rationale: Microstructure cases may be recovered with flags for tolerant downstream uses when scale and daily VWAP alignment are clean and microstructure friction is acceptable.

nodes.label: 1m Alignment Recovery Policy
nodes.rationale: A subset can be recovered for limited use when daily alignment is strong, bad-data and scale-mismatch signatures are absent, and the 1m conflict is bounded and documented.

nodes.label: Strict Generic Review Recovery Rule
nodes.rationale: Recover generic review with a flag when scale is near 1x, VWAP difference is at most 0.5 percent, outside-daily share is at most 1 percent, and outside-1m share is at most 15 percent.

nodes.label: Extended Generic Review Recovery Rule
nodes.rationale: The sensitivity rule allows VWAP difference up to 1 percent, outside-daily share up to 2 percent, and outside-1m share up to 20 percent while retaining near-1x scale.

nodes.label: Trades Recovery Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Recovery priority is review_no_1m_reference, generic review, review_microstructure, review_1m_reference_alignment, then reference_scale_mismatch; bad_data is not recovered by default.

nodes.label: Final Trades Recovery Policy
nodes.rationale: The final output distinguishes good, recoverable_with_flag, review_not_rehabilitated, and bad, using the strict generic-review rule as the official baseline and the extended rule as sensitivity.

nodes.label: Trades Closeout Verdict
nodes.rationale: Trades has a small real bad core, a clean but scarce good bucket, a large review mass recoverable under explicit flagged rules, and a residual review_not_rehabilitated population.

nodes.label: Canonical 57f Full Clean Fast Same Schema State
nodes.norm_label: canonical 57f full clean fast same schema state

nodes.label: Semantic Milestone Refresh
nodes.rationale: Graphify should be refreshed when changes alter the semantic map agents need, rather than after every Git commit.

nodes.label: Controlled Leaf Rebuild
nodes.rationale: Affected leaves are rebuilt at semantic milestones, while root integration occurs only in a dedicated window when required.

nodes.label: Controlled Scope Mapping
nodes.rationale: Historical evidence is mapped with controlled scopes so final authority is not mixed with exploratory notebooks, images, physical data files, or runtime outputs.

nodes.label: Default Corpus Exclusions
nodes.rationale: Generated graphs, notebooks, physical data files, images, caches, and runtime directories are excluded to preserve the leaf as a decision and governance map.

nodes.label: Downstream Evidence Map
nodes.rationale: The leaf supports design and review of downstream tables but does not promote them; promotion still requires physical profiling and live contracts in 01_foundations.
